headline: A 2019 executive order ended a federal government reporting requirement that had been set by an earlier order.
what_it_does: This order cancels a reporting requirement that federal officials previously had to follow. The title alone does not say which report was ended, who had to file it, or what it covered. Without more detail, its specific effects cannot be described with certainty.

who_it_affects.how: Officials who had been required to prepare and release the report no longer have to do so.
People who relied on the report for information would no longer receive it under this requirement.

when_it_takes_effect: The available material does not say; executive orders usually take effect when signed, which here was March 6, 2019.
